verdict.rationale: No framework-specific adapters are documented. Integration is only possible indirectly: an official MCP server works with Claude or any MCP client, cloud browsers expose CDP URLs that Playwright/Puppeteer or your own agents can connect to, and the browser infrastructure is positioned as a 'remote browser for your own agents'. This generic plumbing could be wired into agent frameworks, but none of the named frameworks are mentioned. Missing for 10: documented adapters or integration guides for Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain and CrewAI, plus independent corroboration of framework integration.
